plaatsen.tekst: And Hadarezer sent, and brought out the Syrians that were beyond the river: and they came to Helam; and Shobach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.
And when it was told David, he gathered ➔ all Israel together, and passed over Jordan, and came to Helam. And the Syrians set themselves in array against David, and fought with him.
